title: SwinIR: Image Restoration Using Swin Transformer
grouping: The overview fills the top row; two detail panels share the bottom row, captioned (a) and (b). In the overview the deep stage is a grey rounded container with a bold title ('Deep Feature Extraction'); the other stages stand alone. Detail panel (a) has a pale-blue background matching the blocks it opens and is tied to the first of them by grey dashed zoom lines; panel (b) has a pale-yellow background matching the sub-blocks drawn in (a).
shapes_depth: The shallow-feature and reconstruction stages are flat trapezoids (pale green narrowing, peach widening) with bold names; repeated blocks are tall narrow upright boxes with rotated labels. The global residual is a curved line passing under the deep container to a circled +; inside the detail panels residuals are curved underpasses to circled +. Saturated fills appear only in (b) (green LayerNorm, red MSA, orange MLP) and cyan for Conv. The input is a tiny low-resolution photo on the far left; the output is a much larger photo on the far right.
proposed_highlight: The proposed blocks are expanded two levels deep (block to layer), each detail panel tinted with the fill of the box it opens.
lesson: State the super-resolution task by size alone - a tiny low-resolution photo on the left, a several-times larger output photo on the right - and nest detail panels two levels deep, each tinted with the fill of the block it opens.
notes: Venue not verified here (remembered as ICCV Workshops 2021), so venue = arXiv and year = arXiv preprint year.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: one top-row pipeline left to right: a small LR crop, a green Shallow Feature Extraction trapezoid, a grey Deep Feature Extraction box of six RSTB slabs and a Conv, a residual add, an orange HQ Image Reconstruction trapezoid and a large sharp crop

relations.form: a single horizontal axis across the top, with a long skip running under the deep-feature box from its input to the + before reconstruction

two detail panels in the bottom row: (a) RSTB on a blue panel whose tint matches the RSTB slabs and tied to one slab by two dashed lines, (b) Swin Transformer Layer on a beige panel whose tint matches the STL slabs of (a), with no callout lines
repetition drawn as identical slabs in a row: six RSTB slabs in the top pipeline and six STL slabs in (a), each row ending in a cyan Conv and a residual add
input and output are crops of the same butterfly photo, the input drawn small and the output large to show upscaling

channels.colour: a detail panel's tint matches the block it opens (blue RSTB, beige STL); cyan = Conv; in (b) green = LayerNorm, red = MSA, orange = MLP; green also fills the Shallow Feature Extraction trapezoid and orange the reconstruction trapezoid, so green and orange each carry two meanings
channels.shape: trapezoids = stages that change feature dimension (shallow extraction, reconstruction); tall slabs with rotated labels = layers or blocks; circle-plus = residual addition
channels.line: solid arrows for both the main path and the skip connections, the skips running under each row
channels.frame: a grey rounded box = the deep-feature extraction module; tinted rectangles = detail panels

quality.strengths: Three nesting levels (network, RSTB, STL) are each drawn once and tied by matching tint, so the reader can descend without labels; residual paths are straight runs under each row; the size difference between input and output crops shows the task.
quality.weaknesses: Panel (b) is tied to the STL slabs only by tint, with no callout like (a)'s; green and orange are reused for unrelated blocks across levels; six identical slabs per row spend width on repetition; the window shifting that defines the Swin layer is not drawn, only 'MSA'.

insights.structure: A top-row pipeline (shallow feature extraction -> grey rounded Deep Feature Extraction box of six RSTB slabs + Conv -> HQ Image Reconstruction) above two tinted detail panels: (a) RSTB in blue, (b) Swin Transformer Layer in beige.
insights.data: Input is a small real LR butterfly crop at far left and output a large sharp crop at far right, size difference showing upscaling; blocks are tall narrow slabs with rotated labels (RSTB, STL, LayerNorm, MSA).
insights.emphasis: Zoom-out by dashed lines from one RSTB slab into panel (a), whose blue tint matches the RSTB slab colour; panel (b)'s beige matches the STL slabs inside (a), so colour links each level to its expansion.
insights.flow: Left to right on a single horizontal line in every panel, with long residual skip arrows curving underneath into (+) nodes.
insights.avoid: Panel (b) is not connected to an STL slab by a zoom line as (a) is, so the second level of nesting relies on colour matching alone.

arrangement.units: one top pipeline with a grey rounded group for the deep-feature module, plus two tinted rectangular detail panels below captioned (a) and (b)
